A standard story includes role, means, rationale. Details within means? The criterion says role, means, optional ends/rationale. Yet Minimal wants nothing more than role means rationale; "by entering..." is part of means but maybe detail beyond? The definition "contains nothing more than role, means, and optional ends/rationale." Means can include goal but details?
